environment.description: Flask application deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2, t3.medium) behind an Application Load Balancer with default settings. The ALB performs TLS termination and forwards traffic to port 8080. No WAF is attached. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The application runs as ec2-user with standard shell access. API keys are distributed to NOC team members via internal wiki.

config.infrastructure: AWS ALB -> EC2 (no WAF, no rate limiting)
config.network: Public-facing ALB, SG allows 443 inbound from any
config.iam_role: ec2-instance-role with SSM and CloudWatch permissions
